vagas.titulo: [Hiring] Project Manager – Telecom Expense Management - New York
vagas.texto: ​ Above and Beyond Talent is seeking a Project Manager to support financial and operational initiatives within a Telecom Expense Management Unit. This role focuses on financial analysis, telecom expense optimization, carrier invoice auditing, budget forecasting, and large-scale data analysis. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, advanced Excel experience, and the ability to identify billing discrepancies, improve processes, and uncover cost-saving opportunities. Now Hiring: Project Manager – Telecom Expense Management (Contract – New York, NY) ● Strong experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and expense management. ● Experience with Telecom Expense Management (TEM), telecom billing, and carrier invoice auditing. ● Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables and large dataset analysis. ● Experience identifying billing discrepancies, cost-saving opportunities, and unnecessary expenses. ● Knowledge of ServiceNow and PeopleSoft. ● Experience developing reports and Power BI dashboards. ● Background in vendor invoice reconciliation, budget tracking, and financial reporting. ● Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. ● Must be comfortable working fully onsite, five days per week, in New York. Pay Rate: $70–$75/hour Role type: (Contract) Location: New York, NY (Fully Onsite) Apply now: Apply@AandBTalent.com Use the job title in your subject line for a rapid response. submitted by /u/NYC_Blasian to r/forhire [link]
